_note: Add these as Webhook tools on the ElevenLabs agent. Replace YOUR_SERVER with your backend URL and set header x-api-key to SERVER_KEY.

tools.name: free_slots
tools.description: Get up to six free 30-minute demo slots on the owner's calendar in the next five working days. Returns ISO UTC times.

tools.name: book_meeting
tools.description: Book the demo once the person has agreed a slot and confirmed their email. Sends a Google Calendar invite with a Meet link.

attendee_tz.description: IANA time zone of the attendee, e.g. Asia/Riyadh

tools.name: log_outcome
tools.description: Record how the call ended. outcome: meeting, callback, interested, not_interested, opt_out.
